title: Guideline: sodium intake for adults and children
funder: WHO acknowledges financial support from the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare of the Government of Japan, the Korea Food and Drug Administration, the Korea Health Industry Development Institute and the International Kidney Evaluation Association Japan.
authorConflicts: Guideline group members completed declaration of interests forms before each meeting; declared interests are summarised in an annex; not itemised here.
result: WHO recommends a reduction in sodium intake to reduce blood pressure and risk of cardiovascular disease, stroke and coronary heart disease in adults, and a reduction to less than 2 g/day sodium (5 g/day salt) in adults (strong recommendation); in children, a reduction to control blood pressure, with the adult maximum adjusted downward for energy requirements (strong recommendation).
